snippet.title: Transit - Announcement Trailer | Sarcastic Sock Puppet in a World Looping Itself to Death
snippet.description:
🧦 Wishlist on Steam and play the free demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2988790

Transit: a dark Nordic adventure starring a sarcastic sock puppet in a world looping itself to death.

Your sister is gone. You're trapped beneath the Nordics in an endless night of circling train routes and stranded souls, with only a puppet on your own hand for company - he jokes when things hurt, and you're never quite sure whose side he's on.

Twin Peaks meets The Stanley Parable. It'll make you laugh one loop and gut you the next.

Revealed at Insider Gaming's 28 Games Later. Best Indie Game, Copenhagen Gaming Week 2026. Big Indie Pitch winner, PGC Malmö. Coming to PC in 2027.
